section_title: Configure asset, strategy, and horizon the engine should read
section_intro: The homepage does not invent a winner. It shows where cost tends to concentrate for the selected combination before the full ranking runs.
strategy_hint: Available strategies change according to asset and horizon.
capital_hint: Capital shifts the balance between fixed and variable costs.
insight_scalping: In scalping, cost concentrates almost entirely in execution.
insight_intraday: In intraday trading, cost concentrates in execution as friction repeats.
insight_swing: In swing, execution and carry begin to stack together.
insight_position: In position trading, holding cost becomes dominant.
read_group_fx_core: FX Core: ultra-tight spreads, session liquidity, minimal financing.
read_group_fx_cross: FX Cross: G10 no-USD pairs, wider spreads at rollover, moderate swap asymmetry.
read_group_fx_exotic: FX Exotic: predatory spreads, heavily asymmetric overnight financing.
read_group_index_us: US Indices: 24h liquidity, USD/EUR conversion drag, tight spreads.
read_group_index_eu_core: EU Indices (No Tax): core European sessions only, no government levy.
read_group_index_eu_tax: EU Indices (Tobin Tax): subject to FTT on derivatives, kills HFT.
read_group_index_asia: Asian Indices: off-hours slippage, FX markup burden, low liquidity.
read_group_index_volatility: Volatility Index (VIX): structurally in contango, rollover decay hurts longs.
read_group_equity_us_large: US Large Cap: penny spreads, SEC tick fees, zero government tax.
read_group_equity_us_small: US Small Cap: wide spreads, high borrow fees, hard-to-borrow risk.
read_group_equity_eu_ftt: Equities EU (FTT): spot Tobin Tax (0.1-0.2%) destroys intraday cash trading.
read_group_equity_eu_core: Equities EU (No Tax): pure broker costs, no government levy.
read_group_equity_uk: UK Equities: 0.5% Stamp Duty on spot buy, heavy structural drag.
read_group_equity_adr: ADR: pass-through fees and foreign custodian costs on non-US stocks.
read_group_etf_us_broad: US Broad ETF: SPY/QQQ behaviour, often commission-free but spreads matter.
read_group_etf_us_leveraged: Leveraged ETF: 2x/3x exposure, volatility drag erodes long-term returns.
read_group_etf_ucits: UCITS ETF: harmonised for EU residents, typically wider spreads than US.
read_group_commodity_metal: Metal Spot: XAU/XAG behave like FX, spread + swap dominate.
read_group_commodity_energy: Energy Futures: monthly rollover cost (contango/backwardation) dominates.
read_group_commodity_agri: Agriculture Futures: gap risk, opening slippage, fragmented sessions.
read_group_crypto_major: Crypto Major: BTC/ETH, funding rates every 8h, reasonable spreads.
read_group_crypto_altcoin: Crypto Altcoin: predatory retail spreads, volatile funding, fragmented liquidity.
read_horizon_scalping: Scalping: the engine prioritizes execution friction and slippage.
read_horizon_intraday: Short holding: the engine prioritizes execution drag and turnover.
read_horizon_swing: Intermediate holding: execution and carry begin to stack.
read_strategy_order_flow: Order Flow / DOM: relies on depth of market visibility.
read_strategy_news_reaction: News Reaction: spreads widen dramatically during events.
read_strategy_breakout: Breakout: slippage and timing amplify errors.
read_strategy_vwap_bounce: VWAP Reversion: execution precision around volume profile.
read_strategy_trend_following_day: Trend Following Intraday: capture intraday momentum with tight execution.
read_strategy_trend_following: Trend Following: carry can weigh as much as setup.
read_strategy_range_trading: Range / Channel Trading: holding costs weigh more than execution.
read_strategy_mean_reversion: Mean Reversion: precise execution and contained costs.
read_strategy_macro_trend: Macro Trend Play: multi-week directional bets on fundamentals.
read_strategy_carry_trade: Carry Trade (Swap Yield): funding determines the result.
read_strategy_value_investing: Value / Dividend Capture: tax timing and ex-dividend dates matter.
read_capital_small: Compact capital: fixed costs weigh heavily.
read_capital_large: Large capital: percentage cost becomes more visible.
read_leverage_off: No leverage: profile stays close to direct instrument.
preview_note: Qualitative indicator based on the selected combination.
